verified_facts.fact: 文件類別是規則制定提案（Notice of proposed rulemaking），不是已生效的規則。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: ACTION: Notice of proposed rulemaking.

verified_facts.fact: 刊登卷期與日期：聯邦公報第 91 卷第 69 期，2026 年 4 月 10 日（星期五），Proposed Rules。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: [Federal Register Volume 91, Number 69 (Friday, April 10, 2026)]

verified_facts.fact: 文號 RIN 3064-AG19（報頭那一行的原文，ASCII 連字號）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: RIN 3064-AG19

verified_facts.fact: 涉及的法規部別：12 CFR 第 324、330、350 部。報頭裡這一串與上一條的 RIN 相隔約 39 行，是兩行不同的文字。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: 12 CFR Parts 324, 330, and 350

verified_facts.fact: 官方 SUMMARY 欄說明提案要做三件事：對受 FDIC 監理的獲准支付型穩定幣發行人與受保存款機構實施 GENIUS Act 的部分要求、釐清作為支付型穩定幣準備資產的存款之存款保險範圍、釐清代幣化存款的處理方式。原文用的是 is soliciting comment on a proposal（徵詢意見）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: SUMMARY: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) is soliciting comment on a proposal that would implement certain requirements pursuant to the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act) applicable to FDIC-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers and insured depository institutions, clarify deposit insurance coverage for deposits held as reserve assets for payment stablecoins, and clarify the treatment of tokenized deposits.

verified_facts.fact: 意見截止日：意見須於 2026 年 6 月 9 日前送達 FDIC。這個日期只在聯邦公報原文，新聞稿沒有印。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: DATES: Comments must be received by the FDIC no later than June 9, 2026.

verified_facts.fact: 提案自己把 FDIC 的聯邦公報刊登頁列為意見遞送管道之一（ADDRESSES 欄，並以 RIN 3064-AG19 作為識別）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: ADDRESSES: You may submit comments, identified by RIN 3064-AG19, by any of the following methods:

verified_facts.fact: ADDRESSES 欄列出的第一個管道就是 FDIC 自家那個聯邦公報刊登頁（與 sources[2] 同一個網址）。獨立查核於 2026-09-17 補上此條：文章 FAQ 第 8 題寫「那一頁同時也是這份提案 ADDRESSES 欄列出的意見遞送管道之一」，原紀錄只引了 ADDRESSES 的起首句，沒有引到印出網址的那一行。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: FDIC Website: https://www.fdic.gov/federal-register-publications

verified_facts.fact: 生效規定是法律自己的，不是這份草案的：GENIUS Act 於 2027 年 1 月 18 日生效，或在各聯邦支付型穩定幣主管機關發布任何實施本法的最終規則後 120 天生效，以較早者為準。「以較早者為準」這個限定原樣保留；這個日期是來源自己印的，不是本站換算。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The GENIUS Act will become effective on January 18, 2027, or 120 days after the date on which the primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators issue any final regulations implementing the Act, if earlier.

verified_facts.fact: 四個聯邦支付型穩定幣主管機關：FDIC、OCC、聯準會理事會（FRB）與 NCUA。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators are the FDIC, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (FRB), and the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA).

verified_facts.fact: FDIC 這份提案的射程：FDIC 是「受保州立非會員銀行與州立儲蓄機構」（文件合稱 FDIC-supervised IDIs）獲准發行支付型穩定幣之子公司的主管機關。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The FDIC is the primary Federal payment stablecoin regulator of subsidiaries of insured State nonmember banks and State savings associations (collectively, ``FDIC-supervised IDIs'') approved to issue payment stablecoins.

verified_facts.fact: 硬條件：受 FDIC 監理的獲准支付型穩定幣發行人（PPSI）必須是受保存款機構（IDI）的子公司。後半句是 FDIC 自己的預期，寫成「FDIC 表示」：它預期最早採用者很可能是具備法遵基礎與資本的較大型機構。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Because an FDIC-supervised PPSI must be a subsidiary of an IDI, the FDIC expects that the initial adopters of this technology will likely be larger institutions with the compliance infrastructure and capital necessary to support payment stablecoin issuance.

verified_facts.fact: 保管那一半（擬議 subpart B，350.100 的目的與範圍）適用於受 FDIC 監理者，原文以 including 起頭列舉受保州立非會員銀行、外國銀行的受保州立分行、州立儲蓄機構與獲准支付型穩定幣發行人——including 的清單不是全清單。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: This subpart B sets forth requirements applicable to persons subject to supervision and regulation by the FDIC, including insured State nonmember banks, insured State-licensed branches of foreign banks, insured State savings associations, and permitted payment stablecoin issuers

verified_facts.fact: FDIC 自己畫出與 OCC 的邊界：OCC 的提案比這份提案更廣，因為 OCC 是國民銀行子公司與聯邦合格支付型穩定幣發行人的主管機關。（原文緊接著的破折號插語為 --including nonbank entities--，本紀錄未併入引文。）
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: the OCC's proposed rule is more expansive than this proposed rule because the OCC is the primary Federal payment stablecoin regulator for subsidiaries of national banks and Federal qualified payment stablecoin issuers

verified_facts.fact: 直接適用對象共三類，第三類比「FDIC 監理的機構」更寬：所有維持代幣化存款、或維持作為支付型穩定幣準備金之存款的受保存款機構（IDI）。獨立查核於 2026-09-17 補上此條——原紀錄與草稿的「管到誰」只寫了 FDIC 監理的發行人與保管業者兩類，漏掉這一類，而存款保險那兩個擬議條文正是掛在它上面（擬議 330.11(a)(3) 與 330.3(k) 的條文主語都是 an insured depository institution，沒有限定於受 FDIC 監理者）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The entities that fall under the direct scope of the proposed rule are all FDIC-supervised PPSIs, all FDIC-supervised PPSIs and IDIs that provide payment stablecoin-related custodial and safekeeping services, referred to as FDIC-supervised custodians, and all IDIs maintaining tokenized deposits or deposits held as reserves backing a payment stablecoin.

verified_facts.fact: 前言自己把存款保險那一段的對象寫成「所有 IDI」：提案的目的之一，是就存放於受保存款機構、作為發行人支付型穩定幣準備資產的存款，向所有 IDI 釐清聯邦存款保險法下的保險範圍，並釐清代幣化存款的處理。成本效益分析段另有一句同義的敘述。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: the proposed rule also aims to provide clarity to all IDIs with respect to deposit insurance coverage under the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDI Act) for deposits held at IDIs that serve as reserve assets of a PPSI's payment stablecoin, as well as clarify the treatment of tokenized deposits.

verified_facts.fact: 以 2025 年 9 月 30 日季末為基準時點，FDIC 監理的獲准支付型穩定幣發行人是零家。（同一句還有 4,388 與 2,778 兩個數字，但那一句被 [[Page 18562]] 分頁標記與 \51\ 註腳切開，無法逐字連續引用，故本紀錄與文章都不印那兩個數字。）
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: and supervises zero PPSIs

verified_facts.fact: 核心命題：作為支付型穩定幣準備金存放在受保存款機構的存款，會依 FDIC 的法人存款規則保給獲准發行人，而不以穿透方式保給穩定幣持有人。這是「擬議」，不是現行規定。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: deposits held as reserves backing a payment stablecoin would be insured to the PPSI under the FDIC's coverage rules for corporate deposits, but would not be insured to payment stablecoin holders on a pass-through basis

verified_facts.fact: 條號與方向的第二個佐證（獨立查核於 2026-09-17 補上，因為「擬議新增的 12 CFR 330.11(a)(3) 就是這個機制」是全文最容易被讀反的一句）：前言明寫新段落是加在 12 CFR 330.11(a) 下的第 (3) 段，該小節的標題也印成 Description of the Proposed Rule (Proposed Sec. 330.11(a)(3))，而條文修正指示那一段印的是 Amend Sec. 330.11(a) by adding paragraph (3)。方向是「保給發行人、不穿透給持有人」，三處一致。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The proposed rule would add a new paragraph (3) to 12 CFR 330.11(a).

verified_facts.fact: SMDIA 的金額，文件用的字是「目前」：currently $250,000。這個限定詞原樣保留——它是當期金額，不是固定不變的數字。該字串在全文出現兩次，兩處都是逐字連續。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: currently $250,000

verified_facts.fact: 標準最高存款保險額（SMDIA）目前為 25 萬美元，計算基礎是按存款人、按受保機構、按所有權類別。（同一段另有一句把 SMDIA 與 currently $250,000 連在一起，但被 [[Page 18559]] 分頁標記切開，故改引這一句。）
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: In other words, the SMDIA is $250,000 per depositor, per IDI, for deposits held in each ownership category.

verified_facts.fact: 發行人在同一家受保機構的存款會全部加總後適用保險上限，不論那些存款是穩定幣準備金還是其他用途（例如支付發行人的營運開銷）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Under the proposed rule, all deposits maintained by a PPSI at an IDI would be added together for purposes of the deposit insurance limit, regardless of whether those deposits consist of reserves backing payment stablecoins or serve some other purpose

verified_facts.fact: 存款保險只及於「存款」：FDIC 的存款保險不適用於發行人依 GENIUS Act 可以持有的其他類別準備資產。原文的 may maintain 是可能、不是必然，限定詞照留。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The FDIC's deposit insurance coverage does not apply to other types of reserve assets that a PPSI may maintain pursuant to the GENIUS Act.

verified_facts.fact: 法律本身的禁止規定（FDIC 給的第一個理由）：支付型穩定幣不受美國完全信用擔保、不受美國政府保證、不受 FDIC 的存款保險、也不受 NCUA 的股金保險。文件並寫作相反陳述是違法的。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: shall not be backed by the full faith and credit of the United States, guaranteed by the United States Government, subject to deposit insurance by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, or subject to share insurance by the National Credit Union Administration

verified_facts.fact: FDIC 給的第二個理由：持有人通常以移轉穩定幣的方式交易，資金從未離開那個受 FDIC 保險的存款帳戶，這使它有別於既有的穿透安排。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: without funds ever leaving the FDIC-insured deposit account

verified_facts.fact: 機制條文：擬議新增 12 CFR 330.11(a)(3)。原文的 issuer's and 是已刊登文本的樣子（來源自己的排印），照抄未訂正。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: (3) Notwithstanding any other provision of this part, deposits at an insured depository institution held as reserves for a payment stablecoin, as defined in the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act, are deposits of the permitted payment stablecoin issuer's and insured as corporate deposits for purposes of this part.

verified_facts.fact: 代幣化存款走相反方向：擬議新增 12 CFR 330.3(k)，明定記帳所用的技術或方式不影響一筆負債是不是「存款」。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: (k) Technology used to record deposits. The technology or type of recordkeeping utilized by an insured depository institution to record deposit liabilities does not affect whether those liabilities constitute ``deposits.''

verified_facts.fact: 因此使用代幣化存款的存款人，享有的聯邦存款保險與使用非代幣化存款的存款人相同。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: a depositor using tokenized deposits is afforded the same Federal deposit insurance coverage under the FDI Act as a depositor using non-tokenized deposits

verified_facts.fact: 但並非每一種代幣化的銀行負債都是存款：不論當事人的意圖或陳述如何，不符合法定存款定義的就是非存款商品。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: there may be tokenized bank liabilities that are not deposits, irrespective of an intention or representation that such constitute a deposit

verified_facts.fact: 準備資產至少一比一：準備資產價值在任何時候都必須等於或超過發行人已發行在外的支付型穩定幣總額。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: the reserve asset value of which must at all times meet or exceed the total outstanding issuance value of payment stablecoins issued by the PPSI

verified_facts.fact: 集中度上限：擬議 350.4(f) 要求發行人每個營業日限制對任一合格金融機構的曝險，不論工具類型，不得超過準備資產的 40%。這是擬議數字。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: (f) Asset diversification and concentration. A permitted payment stablecoin issuer shall on each business day limit its exposure to any one eligible financial institution, regardless of instrument type, to no more than 40 percent of its reserve assets.

verified_facts.fact: 月報：擬議 350.4(g) 要求發行人在每月最後一日收盤前，依表 1 的範本在自家網站公布「上一個月最後一日收盤時」的準備資產內容。公布時點與所報時點是不同的兩個月底。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: shall by close of business on the last day of each month, prepare and publish on its website using a format substantially similar to the template provided in table 1 a report containing as of close of business on the last day of the previous month

verified_facts.fact: 月報須經註冊會計師事務所查核，事務所出具書面報告給發行人的審計委員會（無審計委員會者為董事會）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: examined by a registered public accounting firm which will issue a written report of findings to the PPSI's audit committee, or board of directors if there is no audit committee

verified_facts.fact: 贖回時限：FDIC 提議把「及時」定義為不遲於贖回請求日後兩個營業日（擬議 350.5(b)(1)）。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The FDIC is proposing to define ``timely'' to mean that a PPSI shall redeem a payment stablecoin no later than two business days following the date of the requested redemption in proposed Sec. 350.5(b)(1).

verified_facts.fact: 兩個營業日是上限而非目標，FDIC 並自陳市場可能期待遠快於此，因此就天數是否合適徵詢意見。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The FDIC recognizes that the market may expect redemptions to occur far more quickly than two business days.

editorial_brief:
讀者是台灣一般讀者，可能透過跨境支付、匯款或儲值服務接觸到美元穩定幣，也聽過「美國的銀行要發穩定幣了」。角度是制度而非市場：一個主管機關提議要求誰做什麼，以及它明白告訴一般持有人「你有的不是存款保險」。

這份文件對讀者最有價值的，是它乾淨地回答了一個大家默默猜錯方向的問題——如果美國銀行的子公司發穩定幣，我的餘額有存款保險嗎？FDIC 擬議的答案是沒有：躺在銀行裡的準備金依法人存款規則保給發行人、與發行人其他法人存款加總、上限是目前的 SMDIA 25 萬美元，而且不穿透給每一位持有人；同時對代幣化存款提議剛好相反的結論——記在分散式帳本上的存款還是存款，存款人的保險不變。這兩半並排就是本文。它也正好落在本垂直免責 callout 已經寫著的那句「部分服務不受存款保險或投資人保護制度保障」。

五節：(1) 這是提案不是規則——通過日、刊登日、法律的生效公式、意見截止日、查核日仍未見最終規則；(2) 管到誰——四個主管機關、FDIC 只管受保州立非會員銀行與州立儲蓄機構獲准發行的子公司、必須是子公司這個硬條件、保管那一半、與 OCC 的邊界、時點上零家；表格放這一節結尾；(3) 存款保險完整說明，圖解放這一節結尾；(4) 持有人會看到的擬議要求——一比一、40% 集中度、月報＋會計師查核、兩個營業日、最低一枚但須經篩查與開戶、費用七日前通知、不得付息、清理順位；(5) 還沒定案的部分與怎麼自己查。

刻意不談：同日由 Treasury／FinCEN／OFAC 與 OCC＋FDIC＋NCUA 聯名發布的 AML 與制裁方案規則（同批另一篇）、OCC 與 NCUA 的提案（同批另兩篇）、FDIC 2025-12 的申請程序提案與 2026-06-05 的 BSA 提案，以及任何真實穩定幣之間的比較。每個數字都要帶「擬議」。生活情境明寫是編輯設計的例子。
